intro: A privately owned detailing and vehicle protection shop on Lebanon Rd in Mt. Juliet. Careful prep, proven products and work that makes your car look new again.
servicesTitle: Three details. One clear price each.
servicesIntro: From a one-time clean to regular upkeep, pick the service that fits your vehicle.

services.name: Interior Auto Detailing
services.text: A deep clean that blows out cracks and crevices, wipes hard surfaces, vacuums seats and carpets, lightly shampoos mats and cleans interior glass.

services.name: Exterior Auto Detailing
services.text: Degreased wheel wells and tires, rim cleaning, foam cannon wash, clay bar, then dried, dressed and waxed.

services.name: Ceramic Coating
services.text: A durable, hydrophobic layer that shields paint from UV rays and road grime, with a deep gloss that is easier to clean.

services.name: Window Tinting
services.text: Tint that cools the cabin, cuts heat and glare, blocks UV and adds privacy, in shades that meet Tennessee requirements.

services.name: Paint Protection Film
services.text: Clear film on the hood, bumper, mirrors and fenders that guards against rock chips and scratches.

services.name: Windshield Protection Film
services.text: A clear, durable layer that helps protect your windshield from rock chips, cracks and road debris.

why.name: Local, friendly experts

why.name: Honest quotes, fast service
why.text: Upfront pricing and prompt work without cutting corners.

why.name: Years of experience

reviews.text: First of all I was very impressed with the professionalism and friendliness when I called and walked in the door. My husband and I purchased a 2007 used vehicle that has cloth cream colored seats. The seats and carpet were so stained that I didn't think it would ever come clean or the headlights since they were completely fogged up. When I came to pick up the car I was shocked. It didn't look like the same car I dropped off. Absolutely worth every penny.
reviews.name: Mary Hamblen

reviews.text: Unbelievable!! I had a scratch in clear coat that ran down the entire side of my Porsche. Andy felt he could get 40% - 60% improvement. When I picked it up, the scratch was completely gone! My car looks better than the day it rolled off the showroom.
reviews.name: Steve Thomas

reviews.text: Bottom line best detail shop! Professional service and quality workmanship they took a 2014 Silverado and turned it into a showroom vehicle, I have already scheduled my other vehicles for detailing. Impressive!
reviews.name: Michael Shoemake

reviews.text: We had our office tinted and are so happy with how it turned out! It has made it so much cooler in here and is providing the perfect amount of privacy for the business. The employees were very kind and considerate, tried to stay quiet and cleaned up after themselves.
reviews.name: Eden Waggoner

reviews.text: They did a great job with my 2023 Toyota tundra. I’m really happy with the outcome and the price was very reasonable. I was in and out in less than 30 minutes.
